groups.name: Universal symbols
groups.description: The most reusable symbolic forms: planet, energy and the unknown. These should be considered before narrower technical studies.
use: The message needs a symbol that travels across projects
Planet, energy, emergence or the unknown is central
A campaign needs immediate symbolic recognition
avoid: A product scope already has a precise body
The visual would imply a literal machine that the content does not discuss

groups.name: Standard identity
groups.description: Restrained marks with the normal crossed rings and a dark, decisive shadow. These stay closest to Drayker’s identity language.
use: Identity must remain more important than spectacle
A dark shadow and familiar orbit are enough
The animation supports a header, statement or institutional page
avoid: A specific scope body communicates the subject more accurately
The content is about a literal orbital structure

groups.name: Earth studies
groups.description: Earlier realistic-Earth treatments preserved as design studies: day, night, ember and terminator combinations.
use: The campaign is explicitly planetary
Day, night, geography or stewardship carries meaning
A historical design direction needs to be referenced
avoid: The current universal Earth already says enough
A historical study could be mistaken for the production mark

groups.name: Celestial variants
groups.description: Alternative Sun and Black Hole treatments, including the accretion-disk study. Broadly symbolic, but more dramatic than the universal forms.
use: Energy, gravity or the unknown is the actual subject
A long-form story benefits from a more cinematic body
The distinction between horizon and accretion disk matters
avoid: The quieter universal Sun or Black Hole is sufficient

groups.name: System bodies
groups.description: The evolved Turn 10 family: spherical structures that encode each Drayker scope while preserving standard ring behavior.
use: A specific Drayker scope is the subject
The body’s structure explains a system concept
A technical page needs a distinct but coherent scope symbol
avoid: The audience does not know the scope vocabulary
A universal symbol would communicate faster

groups.name: Scope development studies
groups.description: Turns 8 and 9 document two earlier passes over the eight scope bodies. They are valuable references, not default recommendations.
use: Comparing the evolution of a scope mark
Researching body geometry or hard-shadow decisions
A custom extension needs historical precedent
avoid: Publishing a current production identity without review
A Turn 10 system body already covers the need

groups.name: Elemental and abstract bodies
groups.description: Fire, water, earth, air, aether and fractal bodies explore metaphorical matter inside the standard orbital language.
use: A conceptual story genuinely depends on the element
A custom campaign needs an abstract body metaphor
The visual is presented as an exploration
avoid: The animation could be mistaken for an official scope
The metaphor is decorative rather than explanatory

groups.name: Ring customization studies
groups.description: Material, width, nodes, segmentation and built-ring experiments. These deliberately depart from the standard ring and therefore stay near the bottom.
use: The ring material or structure is itself the subject
A project-specific extension needs a documented precedent
The work is clearly labeled as a customization
avoid: A standard ring communicates the idea
The result would be used as Drayker’s default identity

groups.name: Applied machinery examples
groups.description: Literal habitat, extraction, shielding, terraforming and drydock configurations. These are the narrowest and least common applications.
use: The content explicitly describes the depicted machine
The orbital apparatus carries essential technical meaning
A speculative project needs a concrete customization example
avoid: A standard or universal animation can carry the story
The configuration would be presented as the normal brand mark

animations.name: Earth
animations.description: Real coastlines rotate beneath a blue atmosphere while the illuminated limb is cut by the original dark shadow.

animations.name: Sun
animations.description: A living corona and luminous stellar body express energy, origin, growth and emergence without adding machinery.

animations.name: Black Hole
animations.description: A photon ring interrupted by the Drayker shadow creates an open symbol for boundaries, gravity and the unknown.

animations.name: Core mark
animations.description: The orange Drayker body, normal chrome rings and opaque shadow form the closest animated expression of the core identity.

animations.name: Earth gyroscope
animations.description: The standard crossed gyroscope sits over the realistic Earth: the most direct bridge between planet and mark.

animations.name: Fine-line orbit
animations.description: The rings become a restrained thread of light so the globe dominates and the orbit only signs the composition.

animations.name: Day Earth
animations.description: Deep ocean, orange continents and a rotating terminator create a direct daytime planetary reading.

animations.name: Night Earth
animations.description: A near-black planet turns coastlines into glowing filaments while the chrome orbit carries the contrast.

animations.name: Ember Earth
animations.description: The orange brand sphere keeps real continents as dark cutouts, combining Earth with the established identity color.

animations.name: Day–night terminator
animations.description: Daytime land and nocturnal coastline filaments share one globe, divided by a pointer-responsive terminator.

animations.name: Cut ember terminator
animations.description: An orange daytime body and glowing nighttime coastlines combine in a brand-led Earth hybrid.

animations.name: Plasma Black Hole
animations.description: A completely dark sphere, incandescent photon ring and plasma-like crossed rings create a dramatic horizon study.

animations.name: Silhouette Sun
animations.description: Limb-darkened stellar light and an open corona place the orbital structure in silhouette against the photosphere.

animations.name: Black Hole with Accretion Disk
animations.description: A hot accretion disk bends around the horizon, adding a literal gravitational-lensing narrative to the black body.

animations.name: Dk · Geodesic
animations.description: A twenty-face geodesic sphere and white nucleus express a kernel with no privileged axis.

animations.name: DAF · Equal Lobes
animations.description: Twelve equal pole-to-pole lobes form one sphere from autonomous, equivalent parts.

animations.name: BSDK · Weave
animations.description: Opposing spiral bundles weave from pole to pole, making the base structure feel constructed rather than drawn.

animations.name: Dk Network · Mesh
animations.description: A second-order icosahedral mesh carries packets along equal routes in every direction.

animations.name: LCrypt · Armillary Cage
animations.description: Five great circles, a cipher ring and a counter-rotating scan express layered living cryptography.

animations.name: UID · Spherical Iris
animations.description: Concentric shells create an eye-like globe with pupil and highlight for the system’s human identity layer.

animations.name: DFM / DFMP · Zones
animations.description: Symmetric equatorial zones and measured intervals turn protocol into a visibly calibrated body.

animations.name: Emergence · Seed
animations.description: A Fibonacci distribution grows outward from the sphere, expressing uniform emergence from a shared center.

animations.name: Dk · Hard-shadow Study
animations.description: The Dk body under the corrected opaque wedge and single-material graphite orbit.

animations.name: DAF · Hard-shadow Study
animations.description: The DAF federation body tested with a dry-edged opaque shadow and brushed graphite rings.

animations.name: BSDK · Hard-shadow Study
animations.description: The BSDK base-structure body in the corrected hard-shadow, single-material ring system.

animations.name: Dk Network · Hard-shadow Study
animations.description: The network body tested under the decisive opaque wedge and neutral graphite orbit.

animations.name: LCrypt · Hard-shadow Study
animations.description: The security body with a dry opaque shadow and one-material brushed rings.

animations.name: UID · Hard-shadow Study
animations.description: The identity body in the corrected hard-shadow treatment, preserving a neutral orbit.

animations.name: DFM / DFMP · Hard-shadow Study
animations.description: The protocol body tested with the opaque wedge and brushed single-material rings.

animations.name: Emergence · Hard-shadow Study
animations.description: The initiative body tested with the corrected opaque wedge and neutral structural rings.

animations.name: Dk · Kernel Study
animations.description: A wire shell, off-plane internal orbit and pulsing white nucleus make intelligence visibly centered.

animations.name: DAF · Federation Study
animations.description: A small set of linked autonomous cells adheres to one shared sphere.

animations.name: BSDK · Helix Study
animations.description: A double helix wraps the body with visible rungs, treating kernel DNA as the symbol’s matter.

animations.name: Dk Network · Parallel Mesh Study
animations.description: A dense centerless mesh of nodes and links lets every point become a possible route.

animations.name: LCrypt · Living Cipher Study
animations.description: Cipher rings rotate at different speeds while a scan and central key blocks pulse in counterpoint.

animations.name: UID · Iris Study
animations.description: Concentric rings, radial marks and a dark pupil turn the system toward the person.

animations.name: DFM / DFMP · Layer Study
animations.description: Stacked layers brighten as they rise through proposal, discussion, validation and resolution.

animations.name: Emergence · Swarm Study
animations.description: Orbiting particles gather toward a central glow: many volunteers cohering around one emergence.

animations.name: Fire
animations.description: Radial plumes tremble at different rhythms around an incandescent core.

animations.name: Water
animations.description: Concentric waves leave the center while meridional ripples travel underneath.

animations.name: Earth Element
animations.description: Twenty tectonic plates cover the sphere with equal geometry and varied density.

animations.name: Air
animations.description: Seven alternating jet streams ripple around the sphere like atmospheric bands.

animations.name: Aether
animations.description: Three concentric icosahedra rotate at different speeds with illuminated vertices.

animations.name: Fractal
animations.description: Each icosahedron face contains the next scale, repeating one structure through three levels.

animations.name: Thick Chrome
animations.description: The orbit becomes a wide metal ribbon whose highlight moves along the curve.

animations.name: Ember Rings
animations.description: The same gyroscope takes on the hot orange material of the brand.

animations.name: Open Crossing
animations.description: A wider angle and larger radius open the crossing so the globe breathes inside it.

animations.name: Axis Rings
animations.description: A visible rotation axis joins the two rings and makes the mark read as a calibrated instrument.

animations.name: Riveted Copper
animations.description: Thick bronze rings and illuminated rivets shift the language from high-tech to built equipment.

animations.name: Twin Rails
animations.description: Each ring becomes two parallel lines, suggesting an assembled technical rail.

animations.name: Beaded Orbit
animations.description: A sequence of orbiting points reads as solid from a distance and granular up close.

animations.name: Blue Glass
animations.description: A thick translucent ring with a bright core introduces planetary blue into the structure.

animations.name: Moving Nodes
animations.description: Bright nodes travel along a thin orbit as moving points of federation.

animations.name: Chrome and Ember
animations.description: A single ring material transitions from chrome into the orange heat of the brand.

animations.name: Segmented Ribbon
animations.description: A wide band divides into modules like sectors of an orbital structure.

animations.name: Ring Station
animations.description: Wide segmented hulls and radial beams turn both rings into a visible habitat.

animations.name: Solar Collector Study
animations.description: Dark structural panels make the ring shadow read as literal collection from the planet.

animations.name: Horizon Extractor Study
animations.description: Built rings, plasma filaments and the wedge cross a black horizon in an early extraction study.

animations.name: Habitat Ring
animations.description: A wide occupied hull carries seams, beams, modules and moving navigation lights.

animations.name: Extractor
animations.description: Collection panels, intake mouths and radial flow turn the orbit into a literal extraction machine.

animations.name: Shield Array
animations.description: Emitter rings and a faceted scan make protection part of the orbital apparatus.

animations.name: Terraformer
animations.description: Measured plots and illuminated plates appear only where the hull has rewritten the surface.

animations.name: Orbital Drydock
animations.description: Gantries cross the hull while docked vessels travel along the outer track.

animations.name: Captured Star
animations.description: The corona disappears behind the wedge as stellar energy moves into the collector structure.

animations.name: Event Horizon Machine
animations.description: A black body, photon ring, heavy hull and extraction field form the catalog’s most extreme machine.
